ValidationRule.description: 4 sales process fields need to be entered when closing an Agency CS opportunity
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISPICKVAL(StageName, "Closed Won"),
OR( ISBLANK (Current_State__c), ISBLANK (Future_State__c), ISBLANK (Positive_Outcomes__c), ISBLANK (Negative_Consequences__c) ), OR( RecordType.Name = "Agency CS") )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Please complete "Current State", "Future State", "Positive Outcomes", "Negative Consequences" fields when the stage is Closed Won
